_template.title: Test property
_template.description: This is the description of the test property.

amp.title: AMP for Email
amp.description: Support for rendering emails in the AMP format.

bimi.title: BIMI
bimi.description: BIMI (Brand Indicators for Message Identification) is a specification allowing for the display of brand logos next to authenticated e-mails.

css-animation.title: animation
css-animation.description: Tests for the shorthand `animation` property and its longhand equivalents.

css-aspect-ratio.title: aspect-ratio
css-aspect-ratio.description: Sets a preferred aspect ratio for the element

css-at-font-face.title: @font-face
css-at-font-face.description: `@font-face` in CSS allows to include your own fonts inside an email.

css-at-import.title: @import
css-at-import.description: This is the description of the `@import` property.

css-at-media-hover.title: @media (hover), @media (any-hover)
css-at-media-hover.description: This media query tests whether the user's input device[s] (i.e mouse, trackpad etc.) can hover over elements

css-at-media-prefers-color-scheme.title: @media (prefers-color-scheme)
css-at-media-prefers-color-scheme.description: This media query allows to theme for system light and dark mode.

css-backdrop-filter.title: backdrop-filter
css-backdrop-filter.description: Lets you apply graphical effects such as blurring or color shifting to the area behind an element.

css-block-inline-size.title: block-size & inline-size
css-block-inline-size.description: Defines the horizontal or vertical size of an element's block, depending on its writing mode.

css-border-collapse.title: border-collapse
css-border-collapse.description: Sets whether cells inside a `<table>` have shared or separate borders.

css-border-inline-block.title: border-inline & border-block
css-border-inline-block.description: Support for the `border-inline` and `border-block` shorthand properties.

css-border-radius-logical.title: border-radius logical properties
css-border-radius-logical.description: Support for border radius logical properties

css-border-radius.title: border-radius
css-border-radius.description: The `border-radius` CSS property rounds the corners of an element's outer border edge.

css-border-spacing.title: border-spacing
css-border-spacing.description: Sets the distance between the borders of adjacent cells in a `<table>`.

css-border.title: border
css-border.description: The `border` properties set an element's border. This page accounts for all `border` longhands and shorthands.

css-box-shadow.title: box-shadow
css-box-shadow.description: Adds shadow effects around an element's frame.

css-caption-side.title: caption-side
css-caption-side.description: The `caption-side` CSS property puts the content of a table's `<caption>` on the specified side.

css-clear.title: clear
css-clear.description: Sets whether an element must be moved below (cleared) floating elements that precede it.

css-color-scheme.title: color-scheme CSS property
css-color-scheme.description: Changes the default colors of HTML elements. Useful for when you want an email to display only in a dark color scheme or only a light scheme, regardless of user settings

css-column-layout-properties.title: css column properties
css-column-layout-properties.description: Support for the `columns` shorthand and longhand properties.

css-comments.title: CSS comments
css-comments.description: Adds explanatory notes to the code or to prevent the browser from interpreting specific parts of the style sheet

css-conic-gradient.title: conic-gradient()
css-conic-gradient.description: Creates an image consisting of a gradient with color transitions rotated around a center point (rather than radiating from the center).

css-cursor.title: cursor
css-cursor.description: The cursor CSS property sets the mouse cursor, if any, to show when the mouse pointer is over an element.

css-direction.title: direction
css-direction.description: Sets the direction of text or table columns.

css-display.title: display
css-display.description: Sets whether an element is treated as a block or inline element and the layout used for its children.

css-empty-cells.title: empty-cells
css-empty-cells.description: Sets whether borders and backgrounds appear around `<table>` cells that have no visible content.

css-font-size-adjust.title: font-size-adjust
css-font-size-adjust.description: Adjusts the size of lowercase letters relative to the size of uppercase letters.

css-font-size.title: font-size
css-font-size.description: Sets the size of the font.

css-font-stretch.title: font-stretch
css-font-stretch.description: Selecting different font widths (e.g. condensed, expanded)

css-function-light-dark.title: light-dark()
css-function-light-dark.description: Enables setting two colors (one for light and the other for dark mode) for a property.

css-gap.title: gap, column-gap, row-gap
css-gap.description: Properties for adding spacing between grid items, flex items and columns

css-hyphenate-character.title: hyphenate-character
css-hyphenate-character.description: Sets the character (or string) used at the end of a line before a hyphenation break.

css-hyphenate-limit-chars.title: hyphenate-limit-chars
css-hyphenate-limit-chars.description: Specifies the minimum word length to allow hyphenation of words as well as the minimum number of characters before and after the hyphen.

css-important.title: !important keyword
css-important.description: An `!important` declaration takes precedence over a normal declaration.

css-inert-attribute.title: inert
css-inert-attribute.description: This attribute should render elements inactive

css-inset.title: inset
css-inset.description: Shorthand that corresponds to the `top`, `right`, `bottom`, and/or `left` properties

css-intrinsic-size.title: fit-content, min-content, max-content
css-intrinsic-size.description: Sets the height or width relative to its content.

css-line-height.title: line-height
css-line-height.description: Sets the height of a line box. Or, basically, the height of a line of text.

css-linear-gradient.title: linear-gradient()
css-linear-gradient.description: Creates an image consisting of a progressive transition between two or more colors along a straight line.

css-margin-block-start-end.title: margin-block-start & margin-block-end
css-margin-block-start-end.description: Support for the `margin-block-start` and `margin-block-end` css properties.

css-margin-inline-block.title: margin-inline & margin-block
css-margin-inline-block.description: Support for the `margin-inline` and `margin-block` shorthand properties.

css-margin-inline-start-end.title: margin-inline-start & margin-inline-end
css-margin-inline-start-end.description: Support for the `margin-inline-start` and `margin-inline-end` css properties.

css-margin.title: margin
css-margin.description: Support for the `margin` shorthand property and the `margin-left`, `margin-right`, `margin-top`, `margin-bottom` properties.

css-mask-image.title: mask-image
css-mask-image.description: Sets the image that is used as mask layer for an element

css-max-height.title: max-height property
css-max-height.description: Sets the maximum height of an element.

css-max-inline-size.title: max-inline-size
css-max-inline-size.description: Defines the horizontal or vertical maximum size of an element's block, depending on its writing mode

css-max-width.title: max-width
css-max-width.description: This is the description of the `max-width` property.

css-min-block-size.title: min-block-size
css-min-block-size.description: Defines the minimum horizontal or vertical size of an element's block, depending on its writing mode

css-min-height.title: min-height property
css-min-height.description: Sets the minimum height of an element.

css-min-width.title: min-width property
css-min-width.description: Sets the minimum width of an element.

css-modern-color.title: lch(), oklch(), lab(), oklab()
css-modern-color.description: Modern color values: lch, lab, oklch and oklab

css-nesting.title: CSS Nesting
css-nesting.description: A syntax for nesting selectors, providing the ability to nest one style rule inside another.

css-object-fit.title: object-fit
css-object-fit.description: The `object-fit` CSS property sets how the content of a replaced element, such as an `` or `

css-object-position.title: object-position
css-object-position.description: The `object-position` CSS property specifies the alignment of the selected replaced element's contents within the element's box. Areas of the box which aren't covered by the replaced element's object will show the element's background.

css-orphans.title: orphans
css-orphans.description: Sets the minimum number of lines in a block container split on an old page, region or column.

css-outline-offset.title: outline-offset
css-outline-offset.description: Controls the position of an outline.

css-outline.title: outline
css-outline.description: Sets a line outside of the element's border.

css-overflow.title: overflow
css-overflow.description: Sets the desired behavior when content does not fit in the element's padding box

css-padding-block-start-end.title: padding-block-start & padding-block-end
css-padding-block-start-end.description: Support for the `padding-block-start` and `padding-block-end` css properties.

css-padding-inline-block.title: padding-inline & padding-block
css-padding-inline-block.description: Support for the `padding-inline` and `padding-block` shorthand properties.

css-padding-inline-start-end.title: padding-inline-start & padding-inline-end
css-padding-inline-start-end.description: Support for the `padding-inline-start` and `padding-inline-end` css properties.

css-padding.title: padding
css-padding.description: This test includes support for the `padding` shorthand property as well as for `padding-left`, `padding-right`, `padding-top` and `padding-bottom`.

css-position.title: position
css-position.description: Tests for CSS positioning include `relative`, `absolute`, `fixed` and `sticky`.

css-pseudo-class-default.title: :default
css-pseudo-class-default.description: Selects form elements that are the default in a group of related elements.

css-pseudo-class-has.title: :has()
css-pseudo-class-has.description: Represents an element if any of the selectors passed as parameters match at least one element.

css-pseudo-class-lang.title: lang()
css-pseudo-class-lang.description: Matches elements based on the language they are determined to be in.

css-pseudo-element-marker.title: ::marker
css-pseudo-element-marker.description: Selects the marker box of a list item (typically a bullet or number).

css-radial-gradient.title: radial-gradient()
css-radial-gradient.description: Creates an image consisting of a progressive transition between two or more colors that radiate from an origin.

css-resize.title: resize
css-resize.description: Sets whether an element is resizable, and in which directions.

css-rgba.title: rgba()
css-rgba.description: RGB functional notation with alpha-channel transparency value (`rgba()`)

css-scroll-snap.title: scroll-snap
css-scroll-snap.description: Controls panning and scrolling behaviour with snap positions.

css-selector-adjacent-sibling.title: Adjacent sibling combinator
css-selector-adjacent-sibling.description: The adjacent sibling combinator (`h1 + p`) allows to target an element that is directly after another.

css-selector-attribute.title: Attribute selector
css-selector-attribute.description: The attribute selector (`[attr]`) targets elements with this specific attribute.

css-selector-chaining.title: Chaining selectors
css-selector-chaining.description: Chaining selectors (`.foo.bar`) allows to apply styles to elements matching all the corresponding selectors.

css-selector-child.title: Child combinator
css-selector-child.description: The child combinator is represented by a superior sign (`>`) between two selectors and matches the second selector if it is a direct child of the first selector.

css-selector-class.title: Class selector
css-selector-class.description: The class selector (`.className`) allows to apply styles to a group of elements with the corresponding `class` attribute.

css-selector-descendant.title: Descendant combinator
css-selector-descendant.description: The descendant combinator is represented by a space (` `) between two selectors and matches the second selector if it has ancestor matching the first selector.

css-selector-general-sibling.title: General sibling combinator
css-selector-general-sibling.description: The general sibling combinator (`img ~ p`) allows to target any element that after another (directly or indirectly).

css-selector-grouping.title: Grouping selectors
css-selector-grouping.description: Grouping selectors (`.foo, .bar`) allows to apply the same styles to the different corresponding elements.

css-selector-id.title: ID selector
css-selector-id.description: The ID selector (`#id`) allows to apply styles to an element with the corresponding `id` attribute.

css-selector-type.title: Type selector
css-selector-type.description: Type selector or element selectors allow to apply styles by HTML element names.

css-selector-universal.title: Universal selector *
css-selector-universal.description: The universal selector (`*`) allows to apply styles to every elements.

css-shape-margin.title: shape-margin
css-shape-margin.description: Sets a margin for a CSS shape created using `shape-outside`

css-shape-outside.title: shape-outside
css-shape-outside.description: Defines a shape, which may be non-rectangular, around which adjacent inline content should wrap.

css-sytem-ui.title: system-ui, ui-serif, ui-sans-serif, ui-rounded, ui-monospace
css-sytem-ui.description: CSS keywords for specifying system fonts for `font-family`.

css-table-layout.title: table-layout
css-table-layout.description: The table-layout property defines the algorithm used to lay out table cells, rows, and columns.

css-text-align-last.title: text-align-last
css-text-align-last.description: The `text-align-last` CSS property sets how the last line of a block or a line right before a forced line break is aligned.

css-text-align.title: text-align
css-text-align.description: Sets the horizontal alignment of the content.

css-text-decoration-line.title: text-decoration-line
css-text-decoration-line.description: Sets the kind of decoration that is used on text in an element, such as an underline or overline.

css-text-decoration-skip-ink.title: text-decoration-skip-ink
css-text-decoration-skip-ink.description: Specifies how overlines and underlines are drawn when they pass over glyph ascenders and descenders.

css-text-decoration-style.title: text-decoration-style
css-text-decoration-style.description: Sets the style of the lines specified by text-decoration-line.

css-text-emphasis-position.title: text-emphasis-position
css-text-emphasis-position.description: Determines the position of the emphasis mark.

css-text-emphasis.title: text-emphasis
css-text-emphasis.description: Applies emphasis marks to text commonly used in East Asian languages. Tests with text-emphasis, text-emphasis-color & text-emphasis-style properties.

css-text-indent.title: text-indent
css-text-indent.description: Support below refers to supporting a `<length>` value only. This does not include the new `each-line` or `hanging` keywords.

css-text-justify.title: text-justify
css-text-justify.description: Sets what type of justification should be applied to text when `text-align: justify;` is set on an element.

css-text-orientation.title: text-orientation
css-text-orientation.description: Sets the orientation of the text characters in vertical mode.

css-text-transform.title: text-transform
css-text-transform.description: Each of the six `text-transform` values defined by MDN (`capitalize`, `uppercase`, `lowercase`, `none`, `full-width`, `full-size-kana`).

css-text-underline-position.title: text-underline-position
css-text-underline-position.description: Specifies the position of the underline which is set using the `text-decoration property`'s underline value.

css-text-wrap.title: text-wrap
css-text-wrap.description: Controls how text inside an element is wrapped

css-transition.title: transition
css-transition.description: Creates a visual transition when changing CSS properties.

css-unit-ch.title: ch unit
css-unit-ch.description: Support for ch unit, relative to the width of a '0'.

css-unit-em.title: em unit
css-unit-em.description: Support for em unit, relative to the current font-size.

css-unit-ex.title: ex unit
css-unit-ex.description: Support for ex unit, relative to the height of an 'x'.

css-unit-rem.title: rem unit
css-unit-rem.description: Support for rem unit, relative to the root font-size.

css-user-select.title: user-select
css-user-select.description: Controls whether the user can select text.

css-white-space-collapse.title: white-space-collapse
css-white-space-collapse.description: Controls how white space inside an element is collapsed.

css-widows.title: widows
css-widows.description: Sets the minimum number of lines in a block container split on a new page, region or column.

css-word-break.title: word-break
css-word-break.description: Prevents or allows words to be broken over multiple lines.

css-word-spacing.title: word-spacing
css-word-spacing.description: Sets the length of space between words and between tags.

css-word-wrap.title: word-wrap
css-word-wrap.description: The word-wrap CSS property (now standardized as overflow-wrap) controls whether the browser should break words to prevent them from overflowing their container. When set to break-word, it forces otherwise unbreakable strings to wrap onto the next line to avoid layout issues.

css-writing-mode.title: writing-mode
css-writing-mode.description: Sets whether lines of text are laid out horizontally or vertically.

html-align.title: align attribute
html-align.description: This deprecated HTML attribute indicates how an element can be aligned, either horizontally (`left`, `center` or `right`) or vertically for elements like images (`top`, `middle`, `bottom`).

html-audio.title: <audio> element
html-audio.description: This is the description of the `<audio>` element.

html-background.title: background attribute
html-background.description: The HTML `background` attribute can only be used on `<body>`, `<table>`, `<td>` and `<th>` elements.

html-base.title: <base>
html-base.description: Specifies the base URL to use for all relative URLs in a document.

html-body.title: <body> element
html-body.description: Represents the content of an HTML document.

html-cellpadding.title: cellpadding attribute
html-cellpadding.description: Represents the padding around the individual cells of the table

html-cellspacing.title: cellspacing attribute
html-cellspacing.description: Represents the spacing around the individual `<th>` and `<td>` elements

html-code.title: <code> element
html-code.description: A short fragment of computer code.

html-comments.title: HTML comments
html-comments.description: Adds explanatory notes to the code or to prevent the browser from interpreting specific parts of the style sheet

html-dfn.title: <dfn> element
html-dfn.description: It is used to identify a term that is going to be described within the content.

html-dir.title: dir attribute
html-dir.description: Indicates the directionality of the element's text.

html-form.title: <form> element
html-form.description: The ability to submit an HTML form via email, this requires support of at least one form element, at least one form method and either input submit or button submit to pass data to an end point.

html-h1-h6.title: <h1> to <h6> elements
html-h1-h6.description: Support for headings elements in HTML: `<h1>`, `<h2>`, `<h3>`, `<h4>`, `<h5>`, `<h6>`.

html-image-maps.title: Image maps
html-image-maps.description: `` with a `usemap` attribute and associated `` with a `name` attribute and descendant `` elements define a client-side image map.

html-img.title: element
html-img.description: Displays an image into the document

html-lang.title: lang attribute
html-lang.description: The `lang` attribute lets you declare the language of the content of an HTML element.

html-lists.title: <ul>, <ol> and <dl>
html-lists.description: Support for lists in HTML: `<ul>`, `<ol>`, `<li>`, `<dl>`, `<dt>` and `<dd>` elements.

html-loading-attribute.title: loading attribute
html-loading-attribute.description: The `loading` attribute on `img` indicates how the browser should load the image.

html-mailto-links.title: mailto: links
html-mailto-links.description: The `mailto:` URL scheme allows to create links that open a new outgoing email message. It supports different parameters corresponding to header fields, like `cc`, `bcc`, `subject` and `body`.

html-marquee.title: <marquee> element
html-marquee.description: This is the description of the `<marquee>` element.

html-meta-color-scheme.title: color-scheme meta tag
html-meta-color-scheme.description: Changes the default colors of HTML elements. Useful for when you want an email to display only in a dark color scheme or only a light scheme, regardless of user settings. Equivalent to setting the color-scheme CSS property on the root element

html-picture.title: <picture> element
html-picture.description: This is the description of the `<picture>` element.

html-small.title: <small> element
html-small.description: The `<small>` HTML element represents side-comments and small print, like copyright and legal text, independent of its styled presentation.

html-srcset.title: srcset and sizes attributes
html-srcset.description: This is the description of the `srcset` and `sizes` attributes.

html-style.title: <style> element
html-style.description: An HTML element to contain style information, in CSS, for a document or part of a document.

html-svg.title: Embedded <svg> image
html-svg.description: Support for embedded `<svg>` images. See [SVG html](/features/image-svg) for linked external SVG support.

html-target.title: target attribute
html-target.description: Where to display the linked URL on `<a>` elements.

image-apng.title: Animated PNG image format
image-apng.description: Support for animated PNG image format

image-avif.title: AVIF image format
image-avif.description: A modern image format based on the AV1 video format.

image-mp4.title: Video as Image Assets
image-mp4.description: WebKit in Safari supports loading H.264 encoded MP4 video with an HTML tag or as a CSS background.

image-svg.title: SVG image format
image-svg.description: Support for SVG image format, as a linked file. See [SVG html](/features/html-svg) for embedded SVG support.
